commands.name: format
commands.command: rustfmt --check --edition 2021 --config skip_children=true src/graphics/mod.rs src/graphics/mining.rs src/graphics/resources.rs src/minigames/minecraft/mod.rs src/minigames/minecraft/mine.rs src/minigames/minecraft/mining.rs src/scenes/minecraft_mine_dev.rs src/scenes/minecraft_mine_smoke.rs src/scenes/minecraft_mining_smoke.rs tests/minecraft_mining.rs

global_fmt: cargo fmt --check reports existing formatting differences in untouched files; scoped rustfmt --check passed on every changed Rust file.

global_format_check.reason: Pre-existing formatting differences in untouched files, including src/audio.rs; equivalent scoped check passes for all changed Rust files.
